description: WEO SAS and the STURM research team publish STURM-Flood for training and evaluating flood-extent mapping methods. The Zenodo dataset contains 21,602 Sentinel-1 tiles and 2,675 Sentinel-2 tiles, each measuring 128 by 128 pixels at 10 m resolution, with corresponding water masks for 60 flood events globally. Reference delineations come from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service. The dataset is distributed as a public ZIP archive, free under CC-BY-4.0. Exact event acquisition dates and internal image encoding were not checked inside the archive. A limitation is that selected events and sensor-specific sample sizes limit claims of universal flood-detection performance. Modellers could use the labels to check flood-map extraction before linking inundation to exposed infrastructure. The companion GitHub repository documents pretrained-model inference and has its own CC-BY-SA-4.0 statement; that code licence should not be substituted for the dataset licence. The dataset complements hydraulic flood simulations with labelled satellite observations. Neither model performance nor downloaded contents were independently reproduced.
